description: Seven weeks after Congressman Mike Lawler challenged Cait Conley to six televised debates, he has accepted four of them, from NBC, CNN, News 12, and Pix11. Two more are waiting on her. Conley has agreed to nothing, and voters begin casting ballots in seventy-three days.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Lawler for Congress, Inc
title: LAWLER FOR CONGRESS CAMPAIGN ANNOUNCES FOUR DEBATES, WITH TWO MORE BEING FINALIZED, AND CALLS ON CAIT CONLEY AND HER DC CONSULTANTS TO STOP PLAYING CHICKEN - Mike Lawler for Congress
